ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: I need your location to find pubs nearby and point the arrow. Your current or approximate location may be sent to my server; I never store a GPS trail or location history.
ios.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: In the evening, Na pivo can occasionally check whether you are sitting at a pub and remind you to pick the pub and count your beers, even when the app is closed or not in use. I never store a GPS trail or location history.
ios.NSMotionUsageDescription: I use the motion sensors to turn the arrow when you turn.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: I open your gallery so you can pick a profile photo, a photo of the beer menu, or a beer photo for your diary.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: I need the camera to read beers off a menu and to let you snap a beer for your diary.
